title: Los Angeles Kings 1999-2000 STAPLES CENTER COMMEMORATIVE OFFICIAL HOCKEY PUCK
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Fan Apparel & Souvenirs:Hockey-NHL
descriptionText: The product is a Los Angeles Kings 1999-2000 Staples Center Commemorative Official Hockey Puck. It features the VEGUM brand and is designed in multi-color. The puck is associated with the National Hockey League (NHL) and is suitable for unisex adults. It represents the sport of hockey and is made in Slovakia.
